## Motivation

- HIP shared-expert fusion for Glm5Next is admitted only at TP4 and TP8. TP1 is unsharded, so the shared expert already has the same shape as one routed expert, and the gate still refuses it.
- The DSA fp8 partial decode kernel hardcodes a 16-head tile. That tile is not always the one that fills the grid. A RoPE tail cannot take a wider tile: TileLang infers two layouts for `acc_s` and refuses to build a 32- or 64-head tile.

Sampling is unchanged. The 2048-wide top-p prefix is not in this PR.

## Modifications

- Admit HIP shared-expert fusion at TP1 for Glm5Next, beside TP4 and TP8. Any other TP size is still rejected.
- Size the DSA fp8 partial decode head tile to the grid, on gfx950 only. Other targets keep the fixed 16-head tile.
  - The pick is the largest tile in `(64, 32, 16)` that still fills the grid. A tile wider than `num_heads` pads rows without shrinking the grid, so candidates stop at `num_heads`, and every candidate including the fallback satisfies `num_heads <= h or num_heads % h == 0`.
  - A RoPE tail (`d_tail != 0`) pins the tile to 16. GLM-5.3-Flash has `qk_rope_head_dim=0` and keeps the wide tiles.

## Accuracy Tests

Unit tests on one MI355X. No model-level accuracy run is included.

| test | result |
|---|---|
| `test/registered/unit/models/test_shared_experts_fusion_gates.py` (Glm5Next TP1/TP4/TP8 contract) | 48 passed, 1 failed |
| `test/registered/kernels/ops/attention/test_pick_h_per_block.py` | 7 passed |

The one failure is `TestDeepseekV2Gate::test_expert_parallelism_blocks_fusion_off_rocm`, and it fails the same way on `main` on this host. That case asserts the non-ROCm branch of the DeepseekV2 gate, which an MI355X does not take. This PR touches only the Glm5Next gate.

The head-tile helper never returns a tile the kernel assert would reject, never pads past `num_heads`, and returns 16 for every tail.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

No end-to-end benchmark is included in this PR.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). No user-facing flag or environment variable.
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). Correctness is covered by the unit tests above. An end-to-end speed benchmark is not included.
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS). This diff touches `kernels/ops/attention/dsa/tilelang_kernel.py` and `srt/models/glm5_next.py`.
3. Trigger CI with `/tag-and-rerun-ci`. The tests are registered on `base-a-test-cpu` and `stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd-mi35x`.
4. After green CI and the required approvals, ask a Merge Oncall to merge.

+"""Head-tile selection for the DSA fp8 partial decode kernel.
+
+A pick that violates ``num_heads <= h or num_heads % h == 0`` crashes the
+kernel. The policy is the largest safe tile whose grid still fills the GPU.
+"""
+
+import unittest
+
+from sglang.srt.utils import is_hip
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_amd_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_amd_ci(est_time=5, suite="stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd-mi35x")
+
+CU = 256
+BLOCK_PER_CU = 2
+TOPK = 2048
+BLOCK_I = 64
+NUM_HEADS = 64
+TILES = (64, 32, 16)
+
+
+def _pick(seq, num_heads, n_groups, cu=CU, block_per_cu=BLOCK_PER_CU, d_tail=0):
+    from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.dsa.tilelang_kernel import _pick_h_per_block
+
+    return _pick_h_per_block(
+        seq=seq,
+        num_heads=num_heads,
+        n_groups=n_groups,
+        cu=cu,
+        block_per_cu=block_per_cu,
+        d_tail=d_tail,
+    )
+
+
+def _kernel_assert_holds(num_heads, h):
+    return num_heads <= h or num_heads % h == 0
+
+
+class TestPickHPerBlock(CustomTestCase):
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls):
+        super().setUpClass()
+        if not is_hip():
+            raise unittest.SkipTest("tilelang DSA head tiles are the ROCm path")
+
+    def test_pick_never_violates_the_kernel_assert(self):
+        for num_heads in (1, 8, 16, 24, 32, 40, 48, 56, 64, 96, 128, 192):
+            for seq in (1, 12, 80, 512, 14472):
+                for n_groups in (1, 8, 32):
+                    with self.subTest(num_heads=num_heads, seq=seq, n_groups=n_groups):
+                        h = _pick(seq, num_heads, n_groups)
+                        self.assertIn(h, TILES)
+                        self.assertTrue(_kernel_assert_holds(num_heads, h))
+
+    def test_fallback_itself_satisfies_the_kernel_assert(self):
+        """A fixed tile of 16 crashes when num_heads is not a multiple of 16."""
+        for num_heads in range(1, 65):
+            h = _pick(seq=1, num_heads=num_heads, n_groups=1)
+            self.assertTrue(
+                _kernel_assert_holds(num_heads, h),
+                f"num_heads={num_heads} -> h={h}",
+            )
+
+    def test_pick_never_pads_past_num_heads(self):
+        """A tile wider than num_heads keeps head_blocks at 1, so it only pads."""
+        for num_heads in (16, 32, 64, 128):
+            for seq in (1, 12, 80, 512, 14472):
+                for n_groups in (1, 8, 32):
+                    with self.subTest(num_heads=num_heads, seq=seq, n_groups=n_groups):
+                        self.assertLessEqual(_pick(seq, num_heads, n_groups), num_heads)
+
+    def test_production_shapes(self):
+        from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.dsa.tilelang_kernel import _pick_inner_iter
+
+        ni = TOPK // BLOCK_I
+        for seq, expected in ((14472, 64), (80, 64), (12, 32)):
+            with self.subTest(seq=seq):
+                inner_iter = _pick_inner_iter(
+                    seq=seq, ni=ni, cu=CU, block_per_cu=BLOCK_PER_CU
+                )
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    _pick(
+                        seq=seq,
+                        num_heads=NUM_HEADS,
+                        n_groups=ni // inner_iter,
+                    ),
+                    expected,
+                )
+
+    def test_a_tail_pins_the_tile_to_16(self):
+        """Only h=16 builds when d_tail is 64; a wider tile fails layout inference."""
+        for seq in (1, 12, 80, 512, 14472):
+            for num_heads in (32, 64, 128):
+                with self.subTest(seq=seq, num_heads=num_heads):
+                    self.assertEqual(_pick(seq, num_heads, 8, d_tail=64), 16)
+
+    def test_empty_grid_falls_back_to_16(self):
+        self.assertEqual(_pick(seq=1, num_heads=NUM_HEADS, n_groups=1), 16)
+
+    def test_full_prefill_takes_the_widest_tile(self):
+        self.assertEqual(_pick(seq=14472, num_heads=NUM_HEADS, n_groups=1), 64)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
